text:
This boat without oars is mine.

To the wind, to the wind, to the wind alone

it has given its course, its indolent

desolation of sterile distance.


Everything has already lost its hierarchy.

I am full of nothing and beneath the bridge

only the mud, the ill-living

ruin of the water and its silverwork.


Everyone leaves or comes. I remain

for whatever losing courage and fear may give.

To the wind, to the wind, to whatever the wind wants!


A sea without honor and without piracy,

heights of any blue whatsoever,

and this boat without oars that is mine.

translation.title: This Boat Without Oars Is Mine
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the oarless boat surrendered to wind and the speaker's remaining in loss.
